class.name: NeedleAgent
class.brief_description: Agentic LLM for tool-calling from GDScript using the Cactus Needle engine.
class.description:
A lightweight wrapper around the [Cactus Needle 2](https://huggingface.co/Cactus-Compute/needle2) agentic LLM (45M params, ~14 MB) for tool-calling directly from GDScript.
Each [NeedleAgent] instance loads its own copy of the Needle library via [code]dlopen[/code], giving fully isolated model state, conversation history, and tool definitions. Multiple instances can coexist.
[b]Basic usage:[/b] [codeblock] var needle = NeedleAgent.new() needle.set_tools('[{"name": "get_weather", "description": "Weather", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["city"]}}]') needle.load_model("res://addons/needle_for_godot/models/needle2.cact") var result = needle.complete("What is the weather in London?") [/codeblock]
[b]Note:[/b] [method complete] is synchronous and blocks the calling thread. For non-blocking use, wrap it in a [Thread].

method.name: load_model
method.description:
Loads the Needle library (if not already loaded) and the model from [param path]. The path can be a [code]res://[/code] project path or an absolute filesystem path.
Emits [signal loaded] on success or [signal failed] on error. Sets [member model_path] to [param path].
[i]Note:[/i] [member kv_window] and [member threads] are immutable after loading — set them before calling this method.

method.name: complete
method.description:
Sends [param text] to the loaded model and returns a Dictionary containing the engine's JSON response. Blocks the calling thread until the response is ready.
Returns a Dictionary with keys including [code]type[/code] ([code]"call"[/code], [code]"text"[/code], or [code]"error"[/code]), [code]function_calls[/code] (Array of tool calls with [code]name[/code] and [code]arguments[/code]), [code]success[/code] ([bool]), and [code]confidence[/code] ([float]).
Returns an error Dictionary with [code]type = "error"[/code] if the model is not loaded or no tools are defined.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the conversation state. Clears the KV cache and conversation history. Tools and model remain loaded. If tools are defined, the engine is re-initialized automatically.

method.name: set_tools
method.description:
Sets the available tools as a JSON string following the OpenAI function-calling format. Each tool should have [code]name[/code] (String), [code]description[/code] (String), and [code]parameters[/code] (Dictionary with JSON Schema).
If the model is already loaded, this reinitializes the engine with the new tools immediately. Passing an empty string is a no-op.

method.name: get_tools
method.description: Returns the currently defined tools as a JSON string.

method.name: is_model_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the model has been loaded successfully.

method.name: get_needle_memory_bytes
method.description: Returns the Needle engine's RSS memory contribution in bytes. Linux only — returns 0 on other platforms.

members.member: Path to the [code].cact[/code] model file. Set before calling [method load_model].
System prompt prepended to every query sent to the model.
Maximum number of tokens to generate per response. Range: 1–1024.
If [code]true[/code], the agent automatically searches for the model and library on initialization.
KV cache window size. Lower values are faster for tool-calling (16 recommended). Immutable after [method load_model] is called. Range: 16–1024.
Number of internal threads for the Needle engine. 0 = auto-detect (recommended). Immutable after [method load_model] is called. Range: 0–16.

signal.name: loaded
signal.description: Emitted when the model has been loaded successfully and is ready for inference.

signal.name: failed
signal.description: Emitted when any error occurs during library loading, model loading, or initialization. [param error] contains a human-readable error message.
